entities.name: József Zichy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Count József Zichy de Zich et Vásonkeő was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Agriculture, Industry and Trade between 1872 and 1874 and as Minister of Public Works and Transport from 1873 to 1875. He was the first governor of Fiume since 1870.

entities.summary: Count József Zichy de Zich et Vásonkeő was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Agriculture, Industry and Trade between 1872 and 1874 and as Minister of Public Works and Transport from 1873 to 1875. He was the first governor of Fiume since 1870.
